transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… my family says I needed to come in. They’re upset because I spent our savings on wood and lights and things for a display, and I kept working on it after dark. I just… it felt important. Like if I stopped, the house—maybe the whole block—would miss its chance.
Have you been feeling unusually high or euphoric lately?
Yeah… I guess so. Most days I feel kind of charged up, almost happy, like I’m younger again. But if my wife or the contractors start questioning me, I get… heated pretty quick. I’ve yelled some.
Have you had a strong belief that you have a special power or mission that other people would find hard to believe?

I wouldn’t call it a power, exactly… but yes. I feel like I’m meant to make that old Schiller Park house into something people will come see. Nobody really understands light and pictures the way I do.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t noticed voices like that.
Have you ever had a period of at least several days when you felt unusually down or depressed?
I don’t know… not really that I can say. I’ve had rough days, sure, but I don’t think of it as being down for days like that.
Have you had times when that special sense of mission was there even when you were not feeling especially energized or unusually up?

No… I don’t think so. Before I got all charged up about fixing up the house, I wasn’t seeing signs in things like trucks or how the neighbors looked at me. That seemed to come after I got really driven about the project.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual?
I’m not sure. I mean, my sleep’s not what it used to be, but I haven’t really kept track of it.
Lately, have you been sleeping much less than usual and still feeling full of energy the next day?
I can’t really say. Some nights I’m up more than I used to be, but whether I’m sleeping a lot less and still full of energy… I haven’t paid that close attention.
Have you been talking much more than usual lately?
Yeah… I guess so. When I start talking about my plans, I just keep going. My wife says I don’t really let her get a word in.
Before this current spell, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt unusually high, driven, or full of energy like this?
I don’t know… not that I can clearly remember. Maybe I’ve had times I was more worked up, but I couldn’t say it was like this.
About how long have you been feeling this unusually charged up and driven?
I guess… around three months. Since the remodeling started and the house got all turned upside down.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure… I don’t think so. I’ve had down days, sure, but two weeks like that most of the day… I can’t really say.
Have you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable most of the day nearly every day for at least a week?
Yeah… most days, I guess. I feel kind of charged up, almost good, like I’m younger again. But if my wife or those contractors start questioning me, I get mad quick… I start yelling.
Have these symptoms caused serious problems in your life, like major trouble at home, work, or with money?

Yeah… I guess it has. The house is kind of… hard to live in right now. My stuff and projects are in rooms we need, and things aren’t finished.

And, uh… some people have been keeping their distance after we argued. My wife too, sometimes.
Before this current period, was there ever another time in your life when you felt this unusually high, energized, or irritable for at least a week?
I don’t really know. Nothing that stands out like that… not for a whole week, anyway. My memory’s not perfect, but I can’t say yes.
Have other people told you lately that your speech is hard to follow or jumps quickly from one idea to another?
I don’t know… maybe a little. People say I go on too much sometimes, but I don’t think they’ve said it like that—hard to follow or anything.
Was there ever a time when those unusual beliefs were present for at least two weeks when you were not feeling unusually energized or up?

No… I don’t think so. Before I got all charged up with the house plans, I wasn’t reading anything into trucks or neighbors looking at me. That stuff kind of came after I felt driven to make the house into… you know, that bigger project.
During this energized period, have you become convinced of things that other people say are not true?

I mean… yes, I guess. People act like I’m mixed up, but I know this neighborhood was picked for my last big civic art piece. The trucks slowing down, neighbors looking over… those things aren’t nothing. They know.
How old are you?
Did all of this come on very suddenly, within about two weeks?
No… not within two weeks. It’s been more like three months, since the remodeling started and the house got all turned upside down.
